Manjari Nehru Kaul, J. (Oral)
Crm-10155-2025
For the reasons mentioned in the application, same is allowed and copy of air ticket of the petitioner is taken on record as Annexure P-19 subject to all just exceptions.

The petitioner is seeking quashing of order dated 29.02.2020 (Annexure P-1) passed by learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sangrur, whereby he was declared a proclaimed person, in case FIR No.0289, dated 16.11.2018, under Sections 420, 465, 467, 468, 471 of IPC and Section 12(1)(b) of Passport Act, 1976, registered at Police Station City Sangrur, District Sangrur.
Learned counsel for the petitioner, at the outset, submits that the petitioner is ready and willing to appear, and surrender before the trial Court.

Learned counsel submits that in compliance of order dated 30.01.2025, the petitioner has placed on record copy of his air ticket as Annexure P-19 qua his SANJEEV KUMAR CRM-M-26864-2024 (O&M) intended travel to India.
As per photocopy of the air ticket, the petitioner is due to land at Delhi on 27.05.2025.

Hence, in the aforementioned facts and circumstances, the petitioner be protected till his appearance before the trial Court, and directions be given to the trial Court that his bail application, which he would be filing on his surrender, be decided expeditiously.
Notice of motion.

sentences.text: On asking of the Court, Mr. H.S. Deol, Sr. DAG, Punjab, accepts notice on behalf of respondents No.1 and 2.

In view of the limited prayer made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, the instant petition is disposed of with directions to the petitioner to appear and surrender before the trial Court on or before 02.06.2025.
Till then, no coercive steps be taken against the petitioner.
However, this shall be subject to payment of costs of Rs.25,000/- to be deposited with the District Legal Services Authority concerned, which shall be a condition precedent.
It is made clear that in case, the petitioner fails to surrender before the trial Court on or before 02.06.2025, this order shall be of no avail to him, thereafter.

In case, on appearance and surrender,
the petitioner moves an application for bail, the trial Court shall make earnest efforts to decide it expeditiously, in accordance with law.
(MANJARI NEHRU KAUL) JUDGE March 11, 2025 sanjeev
